messages:
marie: quick sync — we need to lock the order for the next model onboard batch. options: falcon-instruct-13b-4bit (cheap, high throughput), orca-mini-30b (small but mixed-quality), and long-context-30b (extended window for RAG). customers pushing all three. proposing RICE but weight Reach by paying customers.

alex: infra quick check — falcon 4-bit kernels mostly done, validation ~7-10 business days. orca needs attention kernel + adapter tuning ~3w. long-context requires KV/cache redesign and mem guardrails, estimate 5-7w unless we reuse eviction code.

sam: quality summary — falcon passes baseline instruction/code evals. orca shows regressions on docs-heavy instruction prompts, needs adapter work. long-context looks strong for multi-doc summarization but we lack long-window unit tests and streaming correctness checks.

jordan: quick RICE sketch (Reach weighted by paid seats):
- falcon-13b: Reach=7 Impact=5 Confidence=7 Effort=2 -> RICE ≈ 122
- orca-mini: Reach=5 Impact=3 Confidence=4 Effort=3 -> RICE ≈ 20
- long-context-30b: Reach=3 Impact=8 Confidence=4 Effort=6 -> RICE ≈ 16
Notes: preliminary numbers; will attach customer counts in sheet.

tess: field note — PLG/SMB chatter wants falcon. two large enterprise customers explicitly asked for long-context to replace custom chunking; they're on Dedicated/Private and have pilot budgets.

alex: runtime tradeoffs — falcon 4-bit fits more instances per GPU (unit cost win). orca can improve with adapter tuning but that's extra ML cycles. long-context without eviction -> p95 memory spikes; treat eviction as a hard blocker if sequencing early.

marie: sequencing options:
A) PLG-first: falcon -> orca -> long-context (fast PLG wins, pricing tailwind)
B) Enterprise-first: long-context -> falcon -> orca (keep big pilots happy)
C) Hybrid: GA falcon for Hosted/PLG, gated long-context for Dedicated pilots, orca deferred.

sam: launch criteria proposal:
- Hosted p95 latency <= 200ms for typical short prompts
- Quality regression <= 5% vs baseline on matched evals
- Customer-smoke: run top-10 customer prompts end-to-end for any account pilot
- Runbook + automatic fallback if error spike >1% for 15m

jordan: rollout plan idea — canary us-west 5% -> 25% -> GA with health checks. Auto-rollback if error rate >1% sustained for 10m. Document fallback behavior and gradual pricing comms.

tess: pricing note — sequencing falcon first unlocks a cheaper chat tier; finance needs cost-per-token delta. I'll draft pricing options and comms.

deploy-bot: workflow created: model-onboard/falcon-instruct-13b-4bit/validation (owner: alex)

eng-infra: flagged — need to investigate prefix/KV eviction patterns; if we can add transient eviction and mem guards in 3w we can consider moving long-context earlier. otherwise keep it as enterprise OKR.

marie: leaning A (PLG-first). we get a fast revenue/opportunity win and can ship cheaper tier. we'll mark long-context as an enterprise OKR and block public GA on KV eviction work. I will communicate timelines to pilots. :thumbsup:

actions:
- alex: perf + cost validation for falcon-instruct-13b-4bit; post perf/cost table here (due Thu EOD)
- sam: build targeted eval suites for orca-mini and long-context (due next Tue)
- jordan: update RICE spreadsheet with paying-customer counts and publish scoring rationale (due Mon)
- tess: draft customer comms and pricing impact note; sync w/ finance (due Mon)
- eng-infra: estimate KV eviction timeline and owners for long-context (due Tue)

marie: scheduling 30m follow-up Mon. speak up before then if you disagree with the order.
